The '''Delfii system''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Star system/Legends|system]]. It was the site of a deep-space [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] summit prior to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].
